description: Open research team from the Shanghai Innovation Institute, the Fudan University NLP Lab and MOSI Intelligence in China, building open-source language, speech and multimodal models. Its MOSS-TTS family covers multilingual voice-cloning TTS, multi-speaker dialogue (MOSS-TTSD), real-time streaming TTS, voice design and the ~100M-parameter CPU model MOSS-TTS-Nano, released mostly under Apache-2.0.
name: OpenMOSS (Fudan)
